info.title: OpenStreetMap API v0.6
info.description:
The OpenStreetMap Editing API v0.6. Allows reading and writing of OSM map data (nodes, ways, relations), changesets, GPS traces, notes, user data, and more.

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0. Read-only endpoints are generally public; write operations require authorization.

Base URL: https://api.openstreetmap.org

Test server: https://master.apis.dev.openstreetmap.org

scopes.consume_messages: Read, update status and delete user messages
scopes.send_messages: Send private messages to other users

versionNumber.name: version
versionNumber.description: The version number of the element

OsmXmlResponse.description: OSM XML document, content wrapped in an <osm> root element

tags.description: Key-value tag pairs, each max 255 unicode codepoints

nodes.description: Ordered list of node IDs referenced by this way (max 2000)

created_count.description: Number of elements created in this changeset

modified_count.description: Number of elements modified in this changeset

deleted_count.description: Number of elements deleted in this changeset

DiffResult.description: OsmChange diff result XML: <diffResult> with <node|way|relation old_id='#' new_id='#' new_version='#'/> entries

400.description: Bad Request – malformed XML, missing parameters, or constraint violation

403.description: Forbidden – authenticated but not permitted (e.g. blocked user or missing OAuth scope)

404.description: Not Found – requested resource does not exist

405.description: Method Not Allowed – wrong HTTP method used

409.description: Conflict – version mismatch, closed changeset, or wrong changeset owner

410.description: Gone – resource existed but has been deleted

412.description: Precondition Failed – referenced element does not exist or is still in use

414.description: Request-URI Too Large – too many IDs in multi-fetch request

429.description: Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded

509.description: Bandwidth Limit Exceeded – downloaded too much data

get.description: Returns all nodes, ways and relations within the given bounding box. Max bounding box area is 0.25 square degrees. Returns at most 50,000 nodes.

get.summary: Download OsmChange document for a changeset
get.description: Returns an OsmChange XML document with all changes in the changeset, sorted by timestamp and version.
Returns changesets matching the given filters, ordered by creation time (newest first by default). Returns at most 100 results.

get.summary: Get GPS track points by bounding box
get.description: Returns GPS track points within the bounding box as GPX 1.0. Returns 5000 points per page. Increment the page parameter to retrieve subsequent pages.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box as left,bottom,right,top. Max width and height is 0.25 degrees.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (0-indexed). Each page contains up to 5000 points.

post.description: Upload a GPX file or archive (.gpx, .tar, .tar.gz, .zip). Processing is asynchronous.
